question.text: Which of the following is NOT a key investor in the global hedge fund (Cat III-equivalent) industry?

explanation.text: The Logic: Retail systematic investors do not participate in hedge funds; key investors are foundations, endowments, SWFs, insurance companies and pension funds. The Trap: The first three ARE key global hedge fund investors per Section 3.3.1.1. Cross-Exam Context: Retail channel participation contrasts with MF/PMS models. Distributor's Pro-Tip: When discussing ecosystem, highlight that Cat III is institutional-dominated.
